arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: The veteran's counsel argued Section 3311 grants separate entitlements for distinct service.
The agency's counsel argued Section 3327 requires a mandatory election between benefits.
Justice Jackson questioned whether the veteran wears both benefit hats simultaneously.
Justice Thomas asked if a continuous service period changes the legal analysis.
